newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica - no comment on alliance report.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica - no comment on alliance report.

text.p: Spanish telecommunications group Telefonica de Espana said on Wednesday it had no comment on a report that it was discussing a strategic alliance with British Telecommunications Plc.
"At the moment we have no comment on the matter," a spokesman for the group told Reuters.

U.K. newspaper Financial Times reported on Wednesday that BT was negotiating a stake in Telefonica Internacional (Tisa), Telefonica's international operation, which has holdings in a few South American countries including Argentina, Chile and Peru.
BT and MCI are in the course of a 12.5 billion pound merger. The two are strong in Europe and in North America.
